issue.title: test_child_is_exempt_while_repeat_roots_stay_capped times out under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py::test_child_is_exempt_while_repeat_roots_stay_capped failed on worker gw11 during monitored just check-full xbfsm7s2nb5e (2026-08-16, tree 30c9ba23b plus uncommitted proc_ownership_closeout remediations that do not touch fakey or runner-slot e2e). harness.join_all([child, repeats[1]]) raised AssertionError: agent parent.child failed: CalledProcessError(124, ['.venv/bin/fakey', '--model', 'fakey-large']). Exit 124 is the harness timeout. Call duration on the failing full-lane node was 25.87s.

Isolation: the exact node passed in 0.55s as part of a 5/5 -p no:randomly bundle immediately after the full-lane failure. No existing task bead names this node (searched test_child_is_exempt, runner_slots, fakey, CalledProcessError 124). This is not the sase-ct ACE TUI class and is not the sase-mv config-cache leak (different worker, different subsystem).

Scope: determine whether parent.child hung waiting for a runner slot under full-suite CPU/process pressure, whether the 124 timeout is just too tight for a loaded 14-worker lane, or whether a slot-accounting race lets the exempt child stall. Re-measure with just test-contention on tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py and the exact node; do not treat a green file-scoped contention run as sufficient if the defect only appears in the whole-suite lane.

Not caused by proc_ownership_closeout.
